footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $13.4M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 88.6% to $4.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 89.4%, versus 89.9% a year earlier, and operating income was $1.1B, up from a $21.7M loss.
Net income rose 55.1% to $1.3B, or $19.57 per share. Operating cash flow was $685M and free cash flow $679M, versus −$84.5M.
watch: Net income includes a $13.4M tax benefit.
sources: argenx SE Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
